title: s3_store.rs tests deleted without replacement in object_store_backend tests
description: The refactor removes the full s3_store.rs test suite (7 tests in transit, 6 in reader) and adds equivalent tests to object_store_backend (transit and reader). However, the reader/s3_store.rs tests now only have 2 tests (round_trip and delete_removes_object), compared to the 6 that were there before. Missing from reader/s3_store.rs after the refactor: put_block_and_get, put_is_idempotent, get_missing_returns_not_found, delete_is_idempotent, delete_nonexistent_succeeds, prefix_is_applied_to_object_path. These moved to object_store_backend tests, which is correct, but the per-backend s3_store reader tests are now a minimal smoke test. This is fine if the intent is to rely on object_store_backend coverage, but a comment saying so would make the intent clear to future readers.
